prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Chicago for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right dentist for a dental implant in Chicago depends on your case (simple single tooth vs full-arch reconstruction), who will restore the crown, your comfort with the provider, and their relevant training and track record.

How to pick the best clinician for your implant
- Choose the appropriate specialist for your needs:
  - Oral & maxillofacial surgeons (OMS) — excellent for surgical complexity, sedation, bone grafting, extractions and complex cases.
  - Periodontists — specialists in the gums and supporting structures; very experienced with implants and bone grafts.
  - Prosthodontists — specialists in restoring teeth; best when complex esthetics or full-mouth restoration are needed.
  - Some general dentists with advanced implant fellowships also do outstanding work on straightforward cases.
- Look for these credentials and signals of competence:
  - Board certification (ABOMS for oral surgeons, American Board of Periodontology, American Board of Prosthodontics) or diplomate status in implant organizations (AAID, ABOI/ID).
  - Extensive implant-specific training (residency, fellowship, continuing education).
  - Use of CBCT 3D imaging and guided implant planning.
  - Published before/after cases and verifiable patient reviews.
  - Clear coordination between the surgeon and the restorative dentist.
- Practical checks
  - Read Google/Yelp/Healthgrades reviews, but weigh clinical credentials more heavily than star count.
  - Ask to see before/after photos of cases like yours and ask for patient referrals if needed.
  - Confirm the implant system/brand used and ask about warranties/guarantees.
  - Ask whether they handle both placement and restoration or whether separate clinicians are involved.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- How many implants have you placed? What’s your success/complication rate?
- What is your specialty and training in implant dentistry?
- Do you use CBCT and guided surgical planning?
- Which implant system do you use and why?
- Who will restore the crown (if you place the implant, who does the prosthetic crown)?
- Do I need bone grafting or sinus lift? How often do you perform those?
- What sedation options are available? What is the total cost and payment options?
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases and patient references?

Where to search for implant dentists in Chicago
- AAOMS (American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons) find-a-surgeon
- American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID) directory
- ABOI/ID diplomate listings
- ADA “Find-a-Dentist,” Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Google + Yelp reviews
- University clinics — e.g., UIC or Northwestern dental clinics for experienced faculty and teaching clinics

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated implant specialists in Chicago if you give me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you prefer an oral surgeon, periodontist, or prosthodontist.
- Draft a concise list of consultation questions you can bring to appointments.
